title_original: Roadmap for Revit migrator to Bonsai BIM - absolute beginner
question_paraphrase: Long-time Revit user new to IFC and Bonsai asks for a learning roadmap and first steps while modelling a small timber house as practice.
phrasing_notes: warm thanks for free tools, states background up front, asks for a roadmap
answer_summary: Follow the community video tutorial series for Blender and Bonsai alongside the practice project.

title_original: Claude Bonsai Construction Drawings
question_paraphrase: Revit veteran testing an AI assistant on Blender/Bonsai construction drawings; wants it to read redlines and update model and sheets, and asks how others balance 3D versus 2D detailing (sections, tags, callouts, lineweights, styles).
phrasing_notes: enthusiastic, self-deprecating about Blender skill, shows progress images
answer_summary: Another member asked if the IfcOpenShell MCP was used; poster plans to try it as the more IFC-native option.

title_original: Native IFC as the source: a reproducible project template for Bonsai, and two questions
question_paraphrase: Trainer shares an IFC4 starter template (storeys, many materials, localised type names) generated by an IfcOpenShell script, and asks where native-IFC modelling in Bonsai still breaks and whether per-country drawing styles should be shared.
phrasing_notes: long structured post with numbered questions, discloses AI-assisted development
answer_summary: Replies: view/layer/panel state is not stored in IFC; deterministic GlobalIds vs merge conflicts need a rule; template merge bug reproduced and filed upstream; plan an IDS for LOIN (EN 17412-1).

title_original: Bonsai Windows
question_paraphrase: User cannot add a window to a wall in an existing project; the Add Window tool does not attach, though new projects work. Wonders if the IFC is corrupt.
phrasing_notes: short, hopeful ('hope it is not lost'), self-answers later
answer_summary: Snap targets were hitting other objects; isolating the walls in local view fixed it. Refresh Geometry or Shift+G helps with openings; limit snap targets.

title_original: Bonsai on Apple ARM, latest macOS ?
question_paraphrase: Mac user finds Bonsai dailies stop activating on newer Blender and macOS Tahoe, with a missing GMP library and 'IfcOpenShell not built' error.
phrasing_notes: informal, pastes the error text, thanks people for corrections
answer_summary: Linked to a GitHub issue; fixed in later builds. A later activation failure on Blender 5.2 came from another add-on (Speckle), not Bonsai.

title_original: German drawing conventions (DIN 1356-1) for Bonsai's 2D output: a reference from vocational training
question_paraphrase: Teacher customises Bonsai 2D output with CSS hatches and post-processing to meet German exam drawing rules, and asks where national conventions should live: Bonsai defaults, a template, or IFC itself.
phrasing_notes: detailed, shares code and PDF, collegial
answer_summary: Link hatches to material categories (or names) via CSS classes; clipped line-path hatches print more reliably than SVG patterns; Inkscape can map classes to layers.

title_original: IfcTester not properly check PredefinedType requirements
question_paraphrase: IDS rule restricting IfcBeam PredefinedType to BEAM or PILECAP passes only one of six beams; user asks if this is a bug in IfcTester or a misunderstanding of IDS.
phrasing_notes: asks 'bug or misunderstanding?', admits fixing it 'by luck'
answer_summary: The Attribute facet reads the literal stored value; use the Entity facet's predefinedType, and test occurrence and type separately since attributes are not inherited.

title_original: IfcConvert - how to control the resulting STEP model's scale?
question_paraphrase: Exporting IFC to STEP with IfcConvert for a simulation tool gives a model 1000x too large whatever --length-unit is set to.
answer_summary: No fix; scaling only worked when IFC unit and importer unit differed. Maintainer suggested reporting it as an IfcConvert bug.

title_original: Export OBJ per level using IfcConvert
question_paraphrase: Can IfcConvert split a model into one OBJ per building level without knowing in advance how many storeys exist or what they are called?
answer_summary: Unanswered on the page.

title_original: [solved] IfcTester IFC 4.3_ADD2 support question
question_paraphrase: Web IfcTester errors when loading a Bonsai-made IFC 4.3 ADD2 file though IDS testing works inside Bonsai; asks whether ADD2 is supported and when fixes reach the site.
phrasing_notes: polite, links the related pull request
answer_summary: The web app uses stable IfcOpenShell releases so support arrives with the next stable release.

title_original: Versioning of Revit IFC exports
question_paraphrase: How can a Revit model be re-exported to IFC and updated in BlenderBIM without losing cost and schedule data added to the earlier IFC?
phrasing_notes: practical, describes desired outcome via a feature in another tool
answer_summary: Two options: a reload-link feature (harder, general) or an import-and-relink of 4D/5D data (simpler, narrower).

title_original: Opening Cuts Skipped in Bonsai Studio 0.9
question_paraphrase: Revit-exported IFCs show an 'Opening Cuts Skipped' message on opening; pressing Apply Openings fixes it. Bug or intended?
context_given: raised Void Limit from 30 to 5000 without effect
phrasing_notes: asks bug-or-intended, offers to share a sample file
answer_summary: No confirmed fix; try the Void Limit setting in Advanced Mode or extract the affected elements into a separate IFC.

title_original: A drawing problem
question_paraphrase: Furniture elements with plan annotation representations show a trace outline and a mesh overlaid in plan drawings; what is wrong?
answer_summary: Maintainer posted a short video walkthrough after receiving the file.

title_original: Bonsai defined Custom Psets documentation anywhere?
question_paraphrase: Is there central documentation for the custom property sets Bonsai creates (EPset_Drawing, EPset_Parametric, georeferencing ones), and could they get a distinguishing prefix?
answer_summary: No reply on the page.

title_original: How to adjust Brep Tesselation Resolution in Bonsai?
question_paraphrase: Curved surfaces from a FreeCAD IFC look faceted after import; is there a tessellation resolution setting in Bonsai?
answer_summary: No such setting; the faceting is baked in by the exporter (IfcFacetedBrep). Scaling the test object up gave smoother output.

title_original: Deleting elements talkes a lot of time
question_paraphrase: Large CityJSON city models imported into Blender take very long to delete unwanted objects; wants speed-up before converting to IFC.
phrasing_notes: terse, pushes back when asked for context
answer_summary: Blender slows with many selected objects; use a Python script or a paid delete add-on.

title_original: IFC to QGIS (GeoPackage)
question_paraphrase: Model georeferenced to EPSG:27700 in Bonsai lands in the ocean in QGIS after converting to GeoPackage.
answer_summary: Units mismatch (mm vs m) and a web-ifc bug ignoring IfcMapConversion; both fixed in newer versions of the tools.

title_original: Canceled Revit Subscription - need help with future file translations to .ifc
question_paraphrase: After cancelling Revit, user wants a paid helper or workaround to keep converting Revit files to IFC.
context_given: export settings partly locked in viewer mode
answer_summary: Revit Viewer mode can export IFC with default settings, but only the final phase and not all options; other readers (Speckle, ODA-based) are alternatives.

title_original: BBIM - two door types with connected properties
question_paraphrase: Two door types from a Revit IFC share an IsExternal boolean; changing one changes the other. Correct? How to see which properties are linked?
context_given: both types point to one property entity (#216)
answer_summary: Revit reuses single-value entities to keep files small; BlenderBIM edited shared entities and was fixed in late 2023.

title_original: BlenderBIM import error
question_paraphrase: IFC generated by the user's own Python app fails to import: IfcAxis2Placement3D has no attribute PlacementRelTo.
phrasing_notes: pastes traceback, asks what could cause it
answer_summary: The file was invalid (IfcLocalPlacement pointing to an axis placement); run the debug-panel validator to list problems.

title_original: Rendering png snapshots for bcf issues?
question_paraphrase: Can IfcOpenShell efficiently render small snapshots for BCF issues generated by ifctester (around 500 issues)?
answer_summary: Options: ifcurl snapshot tools, pyvista scripts, or headless IfcViewer snapshots (WIP).

title_original: Batch editing Object Placement for multiple editable IFC elements
question_paraphrase: How to shift hundreds of editable IFC elements by the same offset (e.g. 350 mm in Y) while keeping IFC in sync, since Edit Object Placement works one element at a time.
phrasing_notes: apologises for confusing wording, thanks helpers
answer_summary: Select all, press G with axis and value, save the IFC; IfcPatch SetFalseOrigin or a Python loop are alternatives.

title_original: 'building-local-placement' in Bonsai
question_paraphrase: Wants the IfcConvert --building-local-placement OBJ result inside Blender/Bonsai for an external tool.
phrasing_notes: informal, explains the downstream tool limitation
answer_summary: Bonsai loads IFC natively with session offsets; change the false origin in the IFC with IfcPatch SetFalseOrigin.

title_original: IfcConvert excluding transparent geometries
question_paraphrase: Can IfcConvert export OBJ for windows and curtain walls but skip transparent glass panes?
answer_summary: No replies captured.

title_original: Bonsai 0.9 & Blender 5.2.2 new Void system improved until ist was broken?
question_paraphrase: Can no longer make arbitrary opening shapes; edits lost in IFC Edit mode and Blender crashes outside it. Argues software should warn about IFC limits.
phrasing_notes: critical title, ends with usability argument
answer_summary: Workaround: Shift+O to create void, Alt+O to edit openings, edit a cube polygon with CAD tools.

title_original: ai-chat.ifcopenshell.org is live!
question_paraphrase: Announcement of a browser chat assistant built on an IFC MCP server for querying and editing IFC models; users ask for Claude and OpenRouter support and report rate-limit errors on large models.
context_given: token-per-minute limits on a large house model
answer_summary: Maintainers added history summarisation, client-side throttling and more providers.

title_original: Open BIM Readiness Toolkit
question_paraphrase: Announces a toolkit assessing an organisation's readiness for open standards using a sample IFC export, plus a utility kit with viewer, IFC2x3 to 4.3 upgrade, health report.
answer_summary: Maintainer asked whether the OpenBIM Pledge had been seen.

title_original: [BlenderBIM] How to set dimensions digits number
question_paraphrase: Dimensions show 6.800; how to get fewer trailing zeros and change dimension text height?
answer_summary: Text height via CSS (text.DIMENSION; tspan too); a DecimalPlaces option was later added.

title_original: Layered walls in BlenderBIM
question_paraphrase: New user asks if multi-layer walls (concrete, insulation, concrete) are possible; Revit IFC vs Blender round-trip shows missing wall materials in Solibri.
answer_summary: Layer sets are the best-supported IFC material form; layered walls were immature and later added, with visualisation caveats.

title_original: IFC Export Newbie Question
question_paraphrase: Blender monkey mesh exported to IFC only partly appears in Revit; primitives work.
answer_summary: Open the IFC with File>Open instead of Link; export as IfcBuildingElementProxy; Revit IFC material support is weak; script GlobalId/material CSV into Dynamo.

title_original: BlenderBIM Add-on: IFC Export Not Visible In Revit
question_paraphrase: Simple cube exported from Blender shows in BIMVision but not in Revit 2021.
phrasing_notes: short, asks if setting is wrong
answer_summary: Object must be in the spatial tree, mesh needs merged vertices, and the IFC add-on shipped with Revit 2021 is outdated.

title_original: Blender Bonsai edit IFC file
question_paraphrase: Decimating a Revit-exported wall in Bonsai loses the reduction after save and reopen; how to edit geometry truly?
answer_summary: Convert swept solids to tessellation, unlink from the class, or enable Clean Meshes in Advanced Mode; otherwise remodel low-poly.

title_original: Should a drawing in Bonsai be a live view rather than a generated file?
question_paraphrase: Argues drawings should be live definitions instead of regenerated SVG/PDF files.
answer_summary: About 21 s per elevation, mostly hidden-line work; options: background generation, change-based regeneration, viewport overlay.

title_original: BIMvoice Academy: free structured openBIM training using free (open source) tools
question_paraphrase: Announces free workshops and videos on IFC, georeferencing and BlenderBIM.

title_original: Addressing some core IfcOpenShell issues
question_paraphrase: Maintainer lists core issues: duplication of spatial structures, georeferencing, work schedules and object types.

title_original: Bonsai import from Revit disregards wall openings
question_paraphrase: Revit 2025 IFC reads fine in SketchUp but wall openings are partly ignored when imported in Blender 4.3 with Bonsai.
phrasing_notes: short bug report, compares with another viewer
answer_summary: Maintainer asked for the IFC rather than the .blend file.

title_original: Error when attempting to annotate Imported IFC file from Revit
question_paraphrase: Annotating an imported Revit IFC gives 'No annotation context Annotation/PLAN_VIEW for drawing'.
answer_summary: Revit IFCs lack the Annotation geometric context; add the context then annotate.

title_original: Drawings & BCF from Georeferenced model
question_paraphrase: Camera zoom and crop settings are lost after save/reopen and drawing cameras shift in georeferenced models.
answer_summary: Camera import skipped the georeferencing offset; fix proposed.

title_original: IFC clash returns location in mm when ifc project in feet
question_paraphrase: IfcClash reports clash locations in millimetres even though the project uses feet.

title_original: Revit IFC to Blender/Bonsai render, problems with faces and shading styles
question_paraphrase: Revit IFC4 in Bonsai: overlapping meshes on site, overlapping faces on walls, flipped normals, and unclear how to save bitmaps to Shading Style.

title_original: Converting to SVG and keeping the IfcSite location
question_paraphrase: Wants SVG conversion output to keep the IfcSite location.

title_original: Extract elements recipe messes up georeferencing
question_paraphrase: The IfcPatch ExtractElements recipe damages georeferencing in the output file.

prompt: this revit ifc came in with a ton of IfcBuildingElementProxy, how many and what were they originally? group by whatever revit category prop is there
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, read Revit category/ObjectType props, group and report; suggest mapping fixes.

prompt: walls from revit dont have their openings cut, windows float in front. can u tell if IfcRelVoidsElement is missing or its just the representation
expected_behavior: Check IfcOpeningElement and IfcRelVoidsElement/IfcRelFillsElement for walls and windows; compare to geometry; report counts and which walls lack voids.

prompt: run this IDS against the model, I want every IfcBeam to have PredefinedType BEAM or PILECAP. which ones fail and why?
expected_behavior: Run IDS audit with entity facet predefinedType, list failing GlobalIds and failure reasons, note occurrence vs type PredefinedType.

prompt: is this model actually georeferenced? whats the EPSG and eastings/northings, and is IfcMapConversion on the project or site
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion and IfcProjectedCRS, report EPSG, eastings, northings, scale, units; mention IFC2x3 ePset alternative.

prompt: move everything 350mm in Y, keep georef intact, save as new file
expected_behavior: Prefer shifting placements/false origin (SetFalseOrigin) over per-element edits; verify map conversion unchanged; write a new file.

prompt: the two door types share IsExternal, change one and the other flips. check whether pset props are shared entities
expected_behavior: Inspect property set relations on both types, detect shared IfcPropertySingleValue instances, report and offer to split them.

prompt: my exported cube doesnt show in revit, can you check if its assigned to a storey and fix it
expected_behavior: Check spatial containment, assign to a storey if missing, check duplicate vertices, advise on Revit IFC add-on version.

prompt: list storeys in the model and give me one obj per storey, no glass
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey names, run per-storey export with filters, exclude transparent materials, explain limitations.

prompt: step export is 1000x too big, units are mm in the ifc. whats going on
expected_behavior: Read IfcUnitAssignment, explain unit mismatch, export with appropriate length-unit, verify bounding box.

prompt: add annotation context so I can draw plans on this revit ifc
expected_behavior: Check IfcGeometricRepresentationContext list; add Plan/Annotation contexts if absent; report.

prompt: compare v1 and v2 ifc, which GlobalIds are new/removed/changed? i have cost items linked to old ones
expected_behavior: Diff by GlobalId, list added/removed/modified elements, flag cost assignments tied to removed items.

prompt: my gpkg lands in the ocean, ifc is in mm, EPSG 27700, check scale on map conversion
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcMapConversion scale and project length unit, compute expected coordinates, explain mm vs m fix.

prompt: how do i add a window to a wall in bonsai? tool wont snap to the wall
expected_behavior: Explain Add Window tool, snap targets, local view isolation, Refresh Geometry.

prompt: my generated ifc wont open, error says PlacementRelTo missing, validate it?
expected_behavior: Run validation, find IfcLocalPlacement referencing axis placement, suggest fix.

prompt: check model with IDS and give me a bcf of the failures
expected_behavior: Run IDS, create BCF topics per failing element with GlobalIds; mention snapshot limits.

prompt: what material layers does the exterior wall type have? thickness of each
expected_behavior: Read IfcMaterialLayerSet for the type, list layers and thickness; note Revit export caveats.

prompt: can you actually edit this ifc or just read it? add a pset Pset_Custom to all IfcDoor and save
expected_behavior: Confirm editing tools available, add pset to all doors via API, save to new file, report count and verify.
